title: Arm A64 Instruction Set for A-profile architecture
section: FJCVTZS, printed page1359; complete reference also qualifies BF16/I8MM supplements.
size_justification: Retained unchanged primary reference for allocation bit diagrams and decode restrictions absent from the older ASL, including the fixed FJCVTZS width and opcode. This is reference material, not a build cache.
page_scope: A64 SIMD&FP variants of the selected instruction families; later SVE/SME variants in the same document are outside this represented base profile.
